user.title: Add a desired state proxy
user.description: Create a proxy entity that represents the desired state of an existing switch or light. The proxy stays available and remembers what you asked for, even when the source device is offline.

data_description.source_entity: The switch or light whose actual state should be tracked.
data_description.proxy_type: Automatic picks a light for light sources and a switch for switch sources.
data_description.proxy_name: Leave empty to derive the name from the source entity.
data_description.hide_source: Hide the source entity in the user interface so only the proxy is shown.

error.already_proxied: This entity is already proxied by another Desired State Proxy.
error.proxy_chain: This entity is itself a Desired State Proxy; chaining proxies is not supported.
error.invalid_proxy_type: A switch proxy can only proxy a switch entity.
error.invalid_source_domain: Only switch and light entities can be proxied.

abort.already_configured: This entity is already proxied by another Desired State Proxy.

data_description.proxy_name: The name shown for the proxy entity.
data_description.hide_source: Hide the source entity in the user interface so only the proxy is shown.
